answers.prompt: How big is our maintenance backlog right now?
answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_work_orders FROM work_orders WHERE status_code = 'OPEN'

answers.prompt: How big is our maintenance backlog right now?
answers.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS backlog_work_orders FROM work_orders WHERE is_current_revision = 1 AND UPPER(status_code) IN ('OPEN','INPR','IN PROGRESS','WAPPR')

answers.prompt: Which site lost the most hours to unplanned downtime last quarter?
answers.sql: SELECT s.site_name, ROUND(SUM(d.duration_minutes) / 60.0, 1) AS unplanned_hours FROM downtime_events d JOIN sites s ON d.site_id = s.site_id WHERE UPPER(d.downtime_category) IN ('UNPLANNED','UNPL') AND d.event_start_ts >= '2026-07-01' AND d.event_start_ts < '2026-10-01' GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY unplanned_hours DESC

answers.prompt: How many corrective labor hours did each site log this year?
answers.sql: SELECT s.site_name, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.labor_unit = 'MIN' THEN w.labor_quantity / 60.0 ELSE w.labor_quantity END), 1) AS corrective_labor_hours FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON w.site_id = s.site_id WHERE w.is_current_revision = 1 AND w.work_order_type IN ('CM','EM') GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY corrective_labor_hours DESC

example_queries.question: What is the current maintenance backlog by site?
example_queries.tsql: SELECT s.site_name, COUNT(*) AS backlog_work_orders FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON w.site_id = s.site_id WHERE w.is_current_revision = 1 AND UPPER(w.status_code) IN ('OPEN','INPR','IN PROGRESS','WAPPR') GROUP BY s.site_name ORDER BY backlog_work_orders DESC

example_queries.question: How many hours of unplanned downtime did each asset class have in August 2026?
example_queries.tsql: SELECT a.asset_class, ROUND(SUM(d.duration_minutes) / 60.0, 1) AS unplanned_hours FROM downtime_events d JOIN assets a ON d.asset_id = a.asset_id WHERE UPPER(d.downtime_category) IN ('UNPLANNED','UNPL') AND d.event_start_ts >= '2026-08-01' AND d.event_start_ts < '2026-09-01' GROUP BY a.asset_class ORDER BY unplanned_hours DESC

example_queries.question: Total labor hours on completed work orders at Decatur Polymer Works this year
example_queries.tsql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.labor_unit = 'MIN' THEN w.labor_quantity / 60.0 ELSE w.labor_quantity END), 1) AS labor_hours FROM work_orders w JOIN sites s ON w.site_id = s.site_id WHERE w.is_current_revision = 1 AND UPPER(w.status_code) IN ('COMP','COMPLETED','COMPLETE','CLOSE','CLOSED','CLSD') AND s.site_name = 'Decatur Polymer Works'
